question: Sachsen-Anhalt Parliamentary Elections: AfD # of seats?
resolution_criteria:
Parliamentary elections to elect the Landtag of Sachsen-Anhalt are scheduled to take place on September 6, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the number of seats won by the AfD party in the Landtag of Sachsen-Anhalt as a result of this election.

If the AfD party contests this election as part of a joint candidate list with one or more parties, all seats won by the joint candidate list will be counted. If the AfD party merges with another party prior to the election, all seats won by the resultant merged party, or any joint candidate list through which it contests the election, will be counted.

If the results of this election are not definitively known by September 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market's resolution will be based solely on the number of seats won by the AfD party in this election.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as published on the official website of the Landtag of Sachsen-Anhalt (https://www.landtag.sachsen-anhalt.de/).

Polls up to 1 September 2026 are in; I'm writing up the report now.

# Sachsen-Anhalt Landtag election (6 Sept 2026): research on AfD seat count

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria point to the official site of the Landtag of Sachsen-Anhalt (landtag.sachsen-anhalt.de). I did not fetch it. It would show no 2026 results before the 6 September vote.
- Electoral rules: the Landtag has at least 83 seats, 41 of them from single-member constituencies. List seats are allocated by Hare/Niemeyer among parties with 5% or more of second votes. Overhang seats stay with the party that wins them, and other parties get compensation seats, so the chamber can grow beyond 83. A party with more than 50% of votes but fewer than half the seats gets extra seats. [wahlrecht.de](https://www.wahlrecht.de/landtage/sachsen-anhalt.htm)
- With 83 seats, a majority is 42. If overhang seats enlarge the chamber, the majority line rises with it. One pre-election projection page assumed 97 seats, with 49 needed for a majority. [leinetal24](https://www.leinetal24.de/welt/sachsen-anhalt-wahl-2026-alle-ergebnisse-in-zahlen-und-grafiken-zr-94476642.html)

## 2. Current status
- As of 1 Sept 2026 nothing has been decided. The vote is on 6 Sept 2026.
- Key mechanics:
  - The AfD's seat total depends on its vote share and on how much of the vote goes to parties below 5% (BSW, FDP, at times the Greens). That wasted vote raises the AfD's share of seats.
  - The number of constituencies the AfD wins also matters. Overhang seats would enlarge the chamber and add compensation seats for other parties.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-28: Forschungsgruppe Wahlen (ZDF): AfD 40, CDU 23, Linke 13, SPD 9, Greens 6, BSW 3, FDP 3. 48% of respondents expected an AfD absolute majority and 44% did not. [dawum](https://dawum.de/Sachsen-Anhalt/), [apollo-news](https://apollo-news.net/letzte-zdf-umfrage-zu-sachsen-anhalt-afd-gewinnt-aber-ohne-eigene-absolute-mehrheit/)
- 2026-08-26: Infratest dimap (ARD): AfD 42, CDU 22, Linke 11, SPD 8, Greens 6, BSW 4, FDP 3. Dawum's seat calculation (83 seats) put AfD plus CDU at 60 seats. [dawum](https://dawum.de/Sachsen-Anhalt/Infratest_dimap/2026-08-26/)
- 2026-08-25: Civey: AfD 43, CDU 21, Linke 12, SPD 7, Greens 5, BSW 4, FDP 4. [dawum](https://dawum.de/Sachsen-Anhalt/)
- 2026-08-12: pollytix: AfD 43, CDU 23, Linke 13, SPD 7, Greens 5. [dawum](https://dawum.de/Sachsen-Anhalt/)
- 2026-08-10: INSA: AfD 42, CDU 22, Linke 13, SPD 6, Greens 4, BSW 5, FDP 4. t-online reported a 21-point AfD lead over the CDU in INSA's polling. [dawum](https://dawum.de/Sachsen-Anhalt/), [t-online](https://www.t-online.de/nachrichten/deutschland/innenpolitik/id_101371622/sachsen-anhalt-wahl-2026-wahlumfrage-zeigt-trend-diese-parteien-bangen.html)
- Late Aug 2026: media framed the late polls as "AfD without an absolute majority". Commentators noted that every extra party clearing 5% makes an AfD majority less likely. AfD lead candidate Ulrich Siegmund said he would not govern without an absolute majority. [leinetal24](https://www.leinetal24.de/welt/umfrage-vor-sachsen-anhalt-wahl-afd-ohne-absolute-mehrheit-zr-94463691.html)

## 4. Base rates and trend
- AfD in past elections:
  - 2016: 24.3%, 25 of 87 seats (from memory).
  - 2021: 20.8%, 23 seats. The chamber grew to 97 because the CDU's 40 constituency wins produced overhang seats (from memory; vote shares confirmed by [statista](https://de.statista.com/statistik/daten/studie/3145/umfrage/endergebnis-der-landtagswahl-in-sachsen-anhalt)).
- AfD polling trend:
  - 2025: about 30-31% (behind the CDU).
  - Sept 2025: 39%.
  - Jan-Mar 2026: 38-39%.
  - May-Aug 2026: 41-43%.
  - Last five polls before 1 Sept: 40-43%, average about 42%. [dawum](https://dawum.de/Sachsen-Anhalt/)
- My own rough seat arithmetic, not a source projection:
  - At 42% AfD, with roughly 9-12% of votes going to parties under 5%, the AfD's share of seats among qualifying parties is about 46-47%. That is roughly 38-39 of 83 seats.
  - At 44% with about 12% wasted, it is about 41-42 seats.
  - If the AfD wins more constituencies than its proportional share, the chamber grows and the AfD's own total rises by those overhang seats.
- Typical polling error in eastern state elections is about 2-3 points per party. Small parties near 5% (BSW, Greens, FDP) swing the seat math a lot. Each extra party in parliament costs the AfD about 2-3 seats.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket ran a market titled "Will AfD win an absolute majority of seats in Sachsen-Anhalt?". A search snapshot showed about 45% Yes, but I could not see the date. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/will-afd-win-an-absolute-majority-of-seats-in-sachsen-anhalt)
- Kalshi ran an "AfD seat count in Saxony-Anhalt" market (KXAFDSACHSEN). A secondary summary cited about 58% for 40 or more seats; the timestamp was not visible. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxafdsachsen/afd-seat-count-in-saxonyanhalt/kxafdsachsen-26sep06)
- One projection page (date unclear) put the AfD at about 41.5% and 47 of 97 seats, two short of a 49-seat majority, with Greens, BSW and FDP at risk of falling below 5%. Treat it with caution. [leinetal24](https://www.leinetal24.de/welt/sachsen-anhalt-wahl-2026-alle-ergebnisse-in-zahlen-und-grafiken-zr-94476642.html)
- Election.de and Poliwave were 403 or not found, so I have no constituency-level projections. [poliwave](https://www.poliwave.com/de/fed/projection/region/saxony-anhalt)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Further final-week polls (INSA, Civey, FGW) are due before the 6 Sept vote. Dawum's chronicle lists entries dated after 1 Sept, which I excluded.
- 6 Sept 2026: election day. Exit polls and projections that evening, then the preliminary official result. The Landeswahlausschuss confirms the final result later.
- Things to watch:
  - whether BSW, FDP and the Greens clear 5%
  - the AfD's number of constituency wins and any overhang or compensation seats
  - turnout and the split between postal and in-person votes

Note: search results also returned articles dated after 1 September 2026. Following the instructions, I ignored them, and nothing above relies on them.
